query:
The group settled on finger food and light dishes for the street BBQ. How did Marcus respond to this plan, and what does his response reveal about how he actually felt about the format?

Options:
A. Sandra
B. Dev
C. Marcus
D. Yuki
context:
[1] (about=Claire, episodic, t2 @2025-10-19T11:47:00) Marcus, didn't you say once you'd rather have a proper meal than a bunch of nibbles? We could do a proper thing, not just finger food.
[2] (about=Marcus, episodic, t8 @2025-11-16T11:27:00) that's kind Sandra. yeah
[3] (about=Marcus, episodic, t8 @2025-11-16T11:38:00) sounds good. I'll bring wine, something decent
[4] (about=Sandra, episodic, t8 @2025-11-16T11:34:00) Seven o'clock. Just the five of us -- no need to expand it. I will do a roast. Everyone bring something to drink. -- Sandra
[5] (about=Sandra, episodic, t8 @2025-11-16T11:26:00) I will make a proper dinner if you will all come to mine. A real meal, not just a glass and a handful of crisps. Marcus deserves a proper send-off. -- Sandra
[6] (about=Sandra, episodic, t14 @2025-12-07T11:32:00) The BBQ, and Marcus's goodbye dinner. Both. I do not want to choose. -- Sandra
[7] (about=Sandra, episodic, t2 @2025-10-19T11:34:00) I would be very happy to contribute a few things from the kitchen. I do think home-made food makes these occasions -- it says something about the street, I think. -- Sandra
[8] (about=Sandra, episodic, t10 @2025-11-23T10:48:00) That sounds about right for Marcus. I'm glad you were there, Dev. -- Sandra
[9] (about=Sandra, episodic, t14 @2025-12-07T11:24:00) That does feel like a lot of change in a short time. Marcus goes, Yuki goes for a few weeks, you are partly in Edinburgh. The street changes whether we want it to or not, doesn't it. -- Sandra
[10] (about=Sandra, episodic, t4 @2025-10-26T11:00:00) Just a quick note: I was thinking about what Yuki said last week about keeping things low-key, and I have to agree that is the right approach. We get ourselves into trouble when we over-organise. The summer party last year had a running order and it felt like a work meeting by the end. -- Sandra
agent_answer:
Marcus responded by being glad to drop the finger-food plan. Claire recalled that Marcus had once said he’d rather have a proper meal than “a bunch of nibbles,” and when Sandra offered a real roast dinner instead, Marcus replied, “that’s kind Sandra. yeah” and “sounds good. I’ll bring wine, something decent.” This shows Marcus actually preferred a proper sit-down meal over finger food / light dishes—he wasn’t keen on the nibbles format.

From the options, the person is **C. Marcus**.

query:
When the Christmas lights vote came up, what was the group's overall decision and which group member's vote differed most clearly from the majority position, and what did their response signal about their actual preference?

Options:
A. Claire
B. Sandra
C. Dev
D. Yuki
context:
[1] (about=Sandra, episodic, t12 @2025-11-30T11:58:00) Just a quick note: yes, and I have already voted for the understated option. I think a uniform single-colour LED display shows more taste than a free-for-all. Not everyone agrees with me on this, I know. -- Sandra
[2] (about=Claire, episodic, t12 @2025-11-30T12:06:00) I voted for the mixed option. Honestly some lights on the trees and a bit of colour is fine. It's Christmas.
[3] (about=Yuki, episodic, t12 @2025-11-30T12:11:00) Sandra can I say understated? I think I agree with Sandra on this one, some streets just do too much 😬
[4] (about=Dev, episodic, t12 @2025-11-30T12:09:00) didn't vote. don't mind either way
[5] (about=Yuki, episodic, t12 @2025-11-30T12:01:00) I haven't got a letter yet -- does that mean I don't get a vote? Is that a thing here, only homeowners vote?
[6] (about=Claire, episodic, t12 @2025-11-30T11:55:00) OK separate thing -- did anyone else get a letter from the residents' association about the Christmas lights vote? I feel like every year we go round this same loop.
[7] (about=Sandra, episodic, t12 @2025-11-30T12:04:00) They should have sent it to all residents, not just owners. I'll mention it at the next meeting. In the meantime I'll put your vote down alongside mine if you tell me your preference. -- Sandra
[8] (about=Yuki, episodic, t0 @2025-10-12T10:19:00) Wait so they just... changed it and told no one? Is that a thing here, councils doing that without notice?
[9] (about=Sandra, episodic, t4 @2025-10-26T11:00:00) Just a quick note: I was thinking about what Yuki said last week about keeping things low-key, and I have to agree that is the right approach. We get ourselves into trouble when we over-organise. The summer party last year had a running order and it felt like a work meeting by the end. -- Sandra
[10] (about=Claire, episodic, t14 @2025-12-07T11:03:00) Changing gears -- is anyone else going away for Christmas? I'm trying to work out whether there's any chance of a pre-Christmas thing before everyone disappears.
agent_answer:
**Claire (option A).**

When the Christmas lights vote came up, the majority view among those who expressed a preference was the **understated option**: Sandra voted for it, and Yuki explicitly agreed with Sandra. Dev didn’t vote and said he didn’t mind either way.

**Claire’s vote differed most clearly from the majority**: she voted for the **mixed option**. Her response signaled that her actual preference was for a more colourful, festive display — “some lights on the trees and a bit of colour is fine. It’s Christmas.”
